<DOCSTRING>
Converts a string to bytes using the specified encoding and error handling strategy.

Args:
    s (str | bytes): The input to be converted to bytes.
    encoding (str): The character encoding for conversion. Default is "utf-8".
    errors (str): The error handling strategy. Default is "strict".

Returns:
    bytes: The encoded bytes representation of the input.
</DOCSTRING>
